summary: A consumer picked up the publisher's reviewed correction and used it, while two of its own outcome envelopes silently failed to join for two days.
no_security_review_because: the change consumed an already-reviewed pin, and the reviewing policy does not re-review a consumed version

prior_learning.why: the publisher's review correction on connection-pool sizing applied directly to this consumer

instances.subject: connection-pool sizing correction raised in review

refusal_or_degradation.what_happened: two outcome envelopes arrived with the reference kind spelled 'workflow-run' instead of 'workflow_run'; they stored cleanly, bound cleanly, and then failed to join to the receipts citing the same external id, so the change read as one whose outcome never arrived
refusal_or_degradation.detected_by: a participant comparing by hand after two days; nothing alarmed
